items.title: How a Solo Ghillie Hunts in DayZ...
items.description:
This time on DayZ, I take on the challenge of surviving completely solo as a ghillie. Without teammates to watch my back, every fight, every decision, and every mistake could mean starting all over again.

My goal was simple - stay hidden, move patiently, and rely on stealth to survive on one of the most competitive servers around. What followed turned into an unforgettable DayZ adventure filled with PvP, high-tier loot, close calls, and the unique experience that only solo gameplay can offer.
